title: A finite-sample Borel--Cantelli inequality under $m$-dependence
summary: We prove an explicit finite-sample version of the Borel--Cantelli lemma under $m$-dependence. Given any $m$-dependent sequence of events $(A_k)_{1\leq k\leq N}$, we show that \[ \mathbb{P}\Bigl(\bigcup_{k=1}^N A_k\Bigr) \ge 1 - \exp\Bigl(-\frac{1}{m+1} \sum_{k=1}^{N} \mathbb{P}(A_k)\Bigr). \] The proof splits the index set into residue classes modulo $m+1$, so that each class consists of mutually independent events, and then applies an elementary product--to--exponential bound.
